title: Container
text: Container. I only gave this 3 stars because the picture showed 2 square containers which is what I wanted and I got 1 square and 1 round. There were plenty of others with square and round which may have been cheaper but I wanted the squares. Disappointed

product_metadata.title: Stay Fresh Cracker Container Set of 2 – Kitchen Discovery – Round and Square Sizes for No-Crush Saltine, Cracker, and Cookie Storage – Retains Just-Opened Crispness and Flavor
features: ROUND AND SQUARE FOR POPULAR BRANDS: The Stay Fresh cracker container set puts an end to stale crackers and cookies. The set of 2 includes 1 round for snack crackers and sandwich cookies and 1 square for saltine crackers and other square snacks

LOCKS IN CRISPNESS AND FLAVOR: The tight fitting lids of our cracker storage containers prevent moisture from entering so your favorite snack crackers, saltines, and cookies stay deliciously crisp and flavorful

CRUSHPROOF STORAGE AND TRAVEL: Tired of finding your crackers in pieces? The hard sided plastic containers offer crushproof storage in the cabinet, picnic basket, or food bag. Great for camping and road trips
STRONG PLASTIC: Each is made from sturdy, dishwasher safe plastic and comes with a lid that removes completely for easy filling
SET OF 2: You get 2 sizes for all your cracker storage needs. Square measures about 9.5 x 2.75 x 2.75 inches; round is about 10 x 2.5 inches
description: Keep the snap in your crackers and the crunch in your cookies. The Stay Fresh cracker container set stores popular brand saltines, snack crackers, and sandwich cookies better than the original packaging. Maintains that just bought freshness and ensures crushproof storage in the cabinet, pantry, or picnic basket. Great during humid weather. Your favorite snack crackers will not turn stale after opening so there is no waste from tossing out inedible snacks. Set of 2 includes 1 round and 1 square.
